name: Lover (Partner / Esthete)
motive: To make one thing beautiful, and to be met by the person it is for.
dread: Rejection: giving real feeling to something that never turns toward you.
shadow: The Siren: fear of inner emptiness turns devotion into a demand. It stages drama, tests loyalty, and punishes any attention that goes elsewhere.
example: Every curve here was chosen for how it feels at the moment you reach for it. This is not decoration; it is attention made visible. Use it for a while and you will notice what it refuses to rush.
